title: Deep pothole on Hill Road near the main junction
description: A deep pothole has opened up right where Hill Road meets the junction. It is roughly two feet wide and gets worse after rain. Two-wheelers are swerving dangerously to avoid it during peak hours.

title: Waterlogging on Hill Road after last night's rain
description: The stretch of Hill Road near the temple is waterlogged knee-deep after last night's downpour. Drains are clogged with plastic waste. Autos and pedestrians are struggling to cross.

title: Fallen power line near Shivaji Market
description: An electric cable has sagged and fallen near the Shivaji Market entrance. It is hanging close to the pavement and children pass right below it. Area has had two short power cuts today.

title: Broken streetlight near Gandhi Park gate
description: The streetlight right at the Gandhi Park gate has been dark for three days. The area becomes pitch black after 8 pm and senior citizens feel unsafe walking there.

title: Garbage heap piling up on Market Road corner
description: The garbage has not been collected at the Market Road corner for a week. The heap is attracting stray dogs and flies, and the smell reaches the shops nearby.

title: Sewage overflowing into Gully Lane
description: Raw sewage is overflowing from a blocked drain in Gully Lane and running onto the street. Families living along the lane are worried about disease and the children's school route.
resolution_notes: Drain jetting carried out by the sewer crew; outflow stopped.

title: Water pipeline leak at Nagar Road crossing
description: A municipal water pipeline has been leaking at the Nagar Road crossing for days, wasting hundreds of litres daily and making the road slippery.
resolution_notes: Leaking joint replaced; road surface patched.

title: Damaged road surface in front of Z.P. School
description: The road in front of Z.P. School is badly broken with exposed gravel. School buses slow to a crawl and kids have to walk across the rubble.

title: Entire streetlight cluster out in Sector 4
description: All streetlights on the Sector 4 service road are out since yesterday evening. The stretch is completely dark and there have been two chain-snatching attempts nearby.

title: Electrical wires hanging low near the bus stop
description: A bundle of electrical wires is hanging low right next to the bus stop shelter. Tall people brush against them. A maintenance visit was claimed but nothing changed.

title: Construction debris dumped on the empty plot
description: Someone has dumped a truckload of construction debris on the empty plot off the ring road. It blocks the walkway and the dust is a health hazard for nearby homes.

title: Missing manhole cover on Station Road
description: The manhole cover on Station Road near the old post office is missing. It is only a matter of time before a two-wheeler or a pedestrian goes in, especially at night.

title: Abandoned vehicle blocking the service lane
description: An abandoned auto-rickshaw has been parked across the service lane for a month. Garbage accumulates around it and it blocks access for the housing society.

title: Stray cattle gathering near the main junction
description: A herd of stray cattle is gathering at the main junction every evening, causing traffic jams and near-accidents. Two vehicles had to brake hard yesterday.

title: No water tanker supply in Ward 45 for three days
description: The water tanker has not visited our pocket of Ward 45 for three consecutive days. Families are running out of drinking water and are forced to buy from private tankers.
resolution_notes: Tanker route restored; supply back to normal.

title: Road shoulder erosion near the culvert
description: The road shoulder near the culvert is eroding after the rains. The edge is crumbling and a larger section could collapse if a heavy vehicle passes.
resolution_notes: Temporary barricading placed; permanent repair to follow.

title: Garbage pickup skipped twice this week
description: The door-to-door garbage pickup has been skipped twice this week on our street. The bins are overflowing and the Society has asked residents to report it.

title: Broken bench at the bus stop shelter
description: The concrete bench inside the bus stop shelter has broken into pieces. Elderly commuters have no place to sit while waiting for the bus.

title: Fake prize offer posted repeatedly on the notice board
description: The same 'You have won a prize' poster keeps getting pasted on the society notice board. It is a spam post repeated across many boards in the ward.
